title: A special kind of topology on $C(X)$ lying between the point-open topology and the topology of uniform convergence
summary: Let $X$ be a topological space. For each transfinite cardinal number $\aleph_α$, we define a topology $C_{\aleph_α}(X)$ on the ring $C(X)$. With $\aleph_α=\aleph_0$, $C_{\aleph_α}(X)$ reduces to the space $C_p(X)$. We prove that for $\aleph_α\geq \aleph_1$, $C_{\aleph_α}(X)$ is pathwise connected if and only if it is connected if and only if $X$ is pseudocompact. Here, we define $\aleph_α$-separable space and furthermore, we show that $X$ is $\aleph_α$-separable when and only when $C_{\aleph_α}(X)$ is metrizable when and only when it is a sequential space.
